name: TOI-700
description: Star of 3,459 K, 31.1 parsecs away, with 4 transiting planets.

radius.source: Pass et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-700 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

mass.source: Pass et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-700 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

temperature.source: Gilbert et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-700 b's parameter set from Gilbert et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: 4 planets cross TOI-700 as seen from Earth: b, c, d, e.
text.introduction: Its radius follows Pass et al. 2026, and its temperature Gilbert et al. 2023.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname GILBERT_ET_AL_2023, PASS_ET_AL_2026): st_teff 3459, st_rad 0.4104, st_mass 0.417

quotes.title: TOI-700
quotes.card: TOI-700 is a red dwarf star in the constellation of Dorado, located 101.4 light-years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: The single planet TOI-700 d is the first Earth-sized exoplanet in the habitable zone of a star discovered by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS).
